# Observe and troubleshoot

## Probes and logs

Liveness `GET /v2/agent/health/live` and readiness `GET /v2/agent/health/ready` on the admin port, unauthenticated. Two log streams: the agent (`AGENT_LOG_LEVEL`, DIDComm, flows, indexer processing, DID and credential operations) and the admin API (`ADMIN_API_LOG_LEVEL`). Ship them to your log system; alert on repeated transaction failures.

## Common failures

| Symptom | Likely cause | Where to look |
|---|---|---|
| Not ready after start | Indexer unreachable or far behind | agent log, `VERANA_INDEXER_BASE_URL`, the indexer's status endpoint |
| `trusted: false` for your own DID | A credential expired or a resource digest changed; an accreditation ended | resolve response `invalidCredentialIds`; the frontend's Agents page |
| Transactions fail with an authorization error | No VS operator record for the entry, or limits exhausted | the entry's record in the frontend; agent balance |
| A flow stuck in `OR_SENT` | The validator's agent is unreachable | the validator's DID Document and endpoints |
| Wallets refuse your offers | You hold no active issuer accreditation for the schema | indexer participant list for your DID |
| OpenID4VP sessions end in error | Nonce or audience mismatch, or the status list check failed | the presentation record |

## Watch your own trust

Resolve your DID on a schedule and alert when `trusted` flips or `expiresAtTime` approaches. The docs' nightly checks do exactly that for the standing documentation agent.
